No specific cards seem to be important, except perhaps Alchemical Redirection at some stage.  We're not 100% certain that Gloomweaver is necessary.  Environment definitely doesn't seem to matter.

Defeat a villain while The Scholar is incapacitated.  The Scholar must have used abilities to make heroes regain HP at least X times.

OR

Defeat a villain while The Scholar is incapacitated.  The Scholar must have used abilities to make heroes regain at least Y HP in total.

 

If those aren't it, the same but enforce the villain is Gloomweaver.

Hey guys. Just poking my head in briefly to say I've got it. Requirements are: Heroes win with Scholar incapped in a batle vs. Apostate or Gloomweaver after healing at least 20HP. Nothing else matters.

Vs. Ennead x2, in Silver Gulch and then Primalis: Scholar healed 25+HP before being incapped (once by heroes, once by villains), and heroes win the game. BWYN but not Truth Seeker were played, only L&E forms used. No unlock. 

Vs. Apostate, in Silver Gulch: Scholar healed 29HP before being incapped by Legacy. No cards in play at incap, neither BWYN nor Truth Seeker were played (Redirection was). Only L&E forms used. Unlocked.

So it's not just any IR villain. Ennead did not give the unlock under near-identical conditions to those in which Apostate did.

 

Cheers!
